starting.name: Prepared Clay
starting.ability: Once during each Materials Yard action you take, after gaining resources, you may pay the normal Clay cost to form 1 vessel of any Shape.
starting.abilityZh: 每次执行材料场行动时限一次：获得资源后，可支付正常黏土费用成型1件任意器形。

starting.name: White Slip
starting.ability: Once during each Potter's Wheel action you take, after forming, choose 1 vessel formed by that action. Give it White Glaze and any Decoration, paying the Decoration's normal cost.
starting.abilityZh: 每次执行拉坯轮行动时限一次：成型后，选择该行动成型的1件器物，施加白釉和任意装饰，并支付正常装饰费用。

starting.name: Rapid Drying
starting.ability: Once during each Glaze & Decoration action you take, after glazing, pay 1 Wood to immediately load 1 ceramic glazed by that action into an empty active Shared Kiln space or your empty unlocked Imperial Kiln.
starting.abilityZh: 每次执行施釉与装饰行动时限一次：施釉后支付1柴薪，立即将该行动施釉的1件陶瓷装入空置有效共窑格，或空置且已解锁的御窑。

starting.name: Kiln Tending
starting.ability: Once during each Kiln Yard action you take, after loading at least 1 ceramic, gain 2 resources in any combination of Clay and Wood.
starting.abilityZh: 每次执行窑场行动时限一次：装入至少1件陶瓷后，获得共2份黏土和/或柴薪，可任意组合。

advanced.name: Large Throwing Wheel
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Potter's Wheel action in which you form at least 1 Vase or Censer, reduce that action's total Clay cost by 1.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：在拉坯轮行动中成型至少1件瓶或炉时，该行动总黏土费用减1。

advanced.name: Measuring Calipers
advanced.ability: Once per round, after you form a vessel, if you have another Shaped or Glazed vessel of a different Shape, gain 1 Coin.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：成型器物后，若你另有一件不同器形的已成型或已施釉器物，获得1铜钱。

advanced.name: Standardised Moulds
advanced.ability: Once per round, after you form a vessel, if you have another Shaped or Glazed vessel of the same Shape, gain 1 Coin.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：成型器物后，若你另有一件相同器形的已成型或已施釉器物，获得1铜钱。

advanced.name: Drying Frames
advanced.ability: Once per round after a Potter's Wheel action, choose 1 shaped vessel formed by that action. Immediately give it any Glaze and Plain Decoration, paying the normal cost of Plain.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：拉坯轮行动后，选择该行动成型的1件器物，立即施加任意釉色和素面装饰，并支付素面的正常费用。

advanced.name: Reworking Table
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Glaze & Decoration action, you may change the Shape of 1 Shaped vessel being glazed to any other Shape. Pay added Clay cost; gain no refund.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：在施釉与装饰行动中，可将正被施釉的1件坯体改为任意另一器形。支付增加的黏土费用；费用降低不退款。

advanced.name: Glaze Palette
advanced.ability: Once per round, during a Glaze & Decoration action, change the Glaze of 1 other Glazed ceramic to any Glaze.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：在施釉与装饰行动中，将另一件已施釉陶瓷的釉色改为任意釉色。

advanced.name: Carving Knives
advanced.ability: Once per round, one Carved Decoration you apply costs 0 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：你施加的1个刻花装饰费用为0铜钱。

advanced.name: Seal Stamps
advanced.ability: Once per round, one Impressed Decoration you apply costs 0 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：你施加的1个印花装饰费用为0铜钱。

advanced.name: Crackle Slips
advanced.ability: Once per round, one Crackle Decoration you apply costs 0 Coins.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：你施加的1个开片装饰费用为0铜钱。

advanced.name: Colour Samples
advanced.ability: Once during each Commission Market action, look at the top 3 Main Orders. Reserve 1 instead of a face-up Order. Put the others on the bottom in any order.
advanced.abilityZh: 每次执行委托市场行动时限一次：查看主订单牌堆顶3张，以预留其中1张替代拿取正面订单；其余牌以任意顺序置于牌堆底。

advanced.name: Protective Saggars
advanced.ability: Once per round after Quality is assigned, spend 1 Wood to improve 1 ceramic: Flawed to Standard or Standard to Fine. Cannot create a Masterpiece.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：判定品第后支付1柴薪，将1件陶瓷从次品提升为合格品，或从合格品提升为精品；不能造就珍品。

advanced.name: Fuel Ledger
advanced.ability: When choosing Bank or Stoke, you may secretly commit 1 additional Wood. Reveal together; the Contribution becomes -2 or +2.
advanced.abilityZh: 选择压火或添薪时，可秘密追加投入1柴薪；同时揭示后，该出柴变为-2或+2。

advanced.name: Test Pieces
advanced.ability: Before Contributions are chosen, you may pay 1 Wood to privately look at the top Fire card, then return it.
advanced.abilityZh: 选择出柴牌之前，可支付1柴薪私下查看窑火牌堆顶牌，然后放回。

advanced.name: Second Firing
advanced.ability: Once per round after Quality is assigned, choose 1 Flawed or Standard ceramic. Reveal 1 extra Fire card and recalculate its Quality using the same Base Heat and position with the new Fire modifier.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：判定品第后选择1件次品或合格品，额外翻开1张窑火牌，以相同基础热度和位置及新的窑火调整值重新计算其品第。

advanced.name: Kiln Furniture
advanced.ability: Once per round, when loading into a High or Low Shared Kiln space, you may treat that ceramic's zone modifier as 0 for this firing.
advanced.abilityZh: 每轮一次：将陶瓷装入共窑高位或低位时，可在本次烧制中将该陶瓷的窑位调整值视为0。
